description: This file is a unit test class for AuthorizationAdvice in the OpenMRS project. It tests privilege notification and exception handling when the user is not authenticated, making use of the JUnit framework and Spring components.

classes.name: AuthorizationAdviceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AuthorizationAdvice, testing privilege notification and authorization exception handling.

methods.name: before_shouldNotifyListenersAboutCheckedPrivileges
methods.description: Tests whether the listeners are notified with correct privileges after a concept is fetched and saved.

methods.name: before_shouldThrowAPIAuthenticationException
methods.description: Tests that an APIAuthenticationException is thrown when the user logs out before accessing a concept.

classes.name: Listener1
classes.description: A Spring component implementing PrivilegeListener that records privileges checked.

methods.name: privilegeChecked
methods.description: Callback method to record whether privileges are granted or lacking.

classes.name: Listener2
classes.description: Extends Listener1, also a PrivilegeListener component, used for testing multiple listeners.
